authorization: Standing matching-material/function/unit waste-service approval, applied only to inspected Swiss construction-waste handling and recycling-stage services with matching material descriptions, operating coordinates and opposite unit reference signs. No new disposal endpoint, recovered-product credit or reconstructed recovery model is introduced.
limitations: Retain each complete native handling inventory per signed kg, using the inspected reference-sign factor of -1. No density, moisture, calorific-value or recovery-yield adjustment is applied.

Native sorting services retain their included freight and waste heat; these are absent as direct exchanges in the inspected source services. No second transport or waste-heat burden is added. Native upstream supplies, technology, vintage and biosphere exclusions remain distinct; matching operating coordinates do not establish inventory or LCIA equality.

The recycling-stage inventories cover the published dismantling and handling boundary only. They do not supply a recovered-product output or avoided-primary-material credit; neither is invented. Native xx name prefixes are retained as source labels, not treated as missing records.
